clauses.title: Evidence and proposal
clauses.text: Field evidence and proposal geometry remain separate. A proposed work area does not rewrite an observation or photograph.

clauses.title: Approximate map
clauses.text: All mapped quantities are approximate and are not a survey.

clauses.title: Professional limitations
clauses.text: No buildability, septic, wetland, drainage, engineering, or regulatory approval is represented.

clauses.title: Debris handling
clauses.text: Debris handling follows the accepted option and any separately approved upgrade.

clauses.title: Changes
clauses.text: Work outside the frozen accepted geometry or scope requires a written change order or new proposal version.

clauses.title: Safety
clauses.text: Work may be paused or rescheduled when weather, water, access, or site conditions are unsafe.

clauses.title: Documentation
clauses.text: Before and after photographs document visible conditions; they do not prove hidden conditions or causation.

clauses.title: Package pricing
clauses.text: Package savings apply only when the complete stated package is accepted as one proposal.

clauses.title: Acceptance
clauses.text: Acceptance freezes the proposal version, selected options, geometry, prices, discount, and payment terms.
